title: The Raven Boys
author: Maggie Stiefvater
summary: Blue, who comes from a family of psychics and has been told she will kill her true love, meets a group of wealthy Aglionby students led by Gansey, who is searching for a sleeping Welsh king.
readIf: you like atmospheric young adult fantasy with quirky characters and friendship at its centre.
skipIf: you want straightforward action and fast answers.
